sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We can commit our full demand for this part to you over the term, and our forecast is rising; a long contract term also offers planning security for your machines. We appreciate the relationship with your family-owned business and understand that larger price steps need committee approval. Would you be able to review the proposal on that basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 30000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our forecast for this part is up 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Our forecast for this part is up 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
Our forecast for this part is up 9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.72 per unit, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 30000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have already taken that volume change data into account.

We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month term and the binding volume of 30,000 units per year. We are pleased to accommodate the 45-day payment terms and the extended contract duration to support your planning security.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We value our working relationship and remain dedicated to supporting your operations with our extensive inventory and dependable service.
